column1: # shortProdForCI per-iteration figures against the orthotope checkout.
# Taken 2026-08-28 on GHC 9.12.4 at -A32m -I0, ox-arrays 0.2.0.1, and the
# orthotope SIBLING CHECKOUT on pr-mikolaj-toVectorListT at 3f8bd02 (verified
# in the build plan as style=local, src=local).  Its released counterpart is
# the *-released.tsv beside it; do not diff a collection against the wrong
# one, the benchmark names being identical across the two.
# bytes_per_iter is the allocated-vs-iters OLS slope and is exact (every fit
# here R2 1.000000); it is the instrument.  seconds_per_iter carries the
# machine and the roster, which the position effect moves up to 10%
# (docs/position-effect.md), so a time difference under that is not evidence.
